en.name: GitHub Copilot CLI
en.description: GitHub Copilot CLI in Textus AI: the models of your Copilot plan read your folder, write and edit your notes, and ask before they change anything.
en.setup: Needs Node.js and a GitHub Copilot plan. Once, in a terminal: npx @github/copilot login.
